title: Dia: meeting tab groups
how: ffmpeg streamed the video from its URL into cutscene's measure (256 px luma, every frame); nothing saved but these numbers and stills in scratch
whyTopTier: Framed tight on the window's top-left corner, the one region where the feature lives: the calendar event, 'Join', then a tab group named after the meeting gathers Meet, notes, Figma and Linear while the speaker floats picture-in-picture. 22.2 s.
instrument: Still 95%: one pull ×0.76 at 2.7 s; the rest is held framing and cuts.

byEye.zoom: the window's top-left quarter at ×2.5; the frame edge cuts through the page
byEye.cards: none in the flow; logo, a blur-morph to 'diabrowser.com' (1.6 s)
byEye.cursor: native pointer at ×2.5, so about 60 px
byEye.frame: the crop is the frame: no backdrop visible
byEye.sound: an audio track with rhythmic onsets (not listened to)

classify: Hand-edited single-flow reel, cropped to a corner of the real window. Conventions: the frame cuts through the window, a large pointer, logo → URL end.

diagnose.observation: The frame cuts through the window instead of showing it whole.
diagnose.principle: Crop to the region: when the feature lives in one corner, the corner is the shot.
Pointer scale tracks frame scale, so the pointer stays visible on a phone.

teaches.text: Crop to where the feature lives; a working zoom of ×2.5.
Camera holds; the flow plays inside one framing (rule 5).

critique.like: Nothing outside the corner ever matters, so nothing outside it is shown.
critique.wish: The tab group's name is the payoff but is small text in the sidebar; a push to it would land it.
critique.wonder: Should cutscene's working zoom anchor to a corner region rather than centre on the target?
